build: Official Nighty Night and related Early Access patch records
observations: Official patches differentiated directional, rapid-fire, armored, kill, and player-damage visual effects.
Enemy graphics, hit boxes, projectile patterns, summoning cues, trap visibility, and chamber selection were revised together.
Damage-number accumulation and interface relevance were changed to reduce clutter.
Attack sounds and feedback timing were revised for selected weapons, enemies, hazards, and expiring states.
inferences: Combat readability is an agreement among rules, collision, animation, effects, audio, environment, and interface.
Adding impact without limiting occlusion can weaken the next decision even when individual hits feel stronger.
limits: Patch notes show revisions but do not publish full event timing or perception-test results.
Observed changes do not prove every channel caused the reported improvement.
